verification_scope: Read-only private connection-identity & Vercel environment metadata audit for REG24 Production vs. local .env.local (374f4f7e). Zero credentials, tokens, or raw URIs logged or stored; zero write queries executed; RAG24 completely untouched.
why_identity_remains_unverified: Vercel Production stores `NEO4J_URI` (`env_id: lOymi3K3YZaPkTHr`, `target: ["production"]`) with `type: "sensitive"`, making its value write-only and non-exportable via `vercel env pull` or Vercel REST API, while Production `main` (`https://reg24-theta.vercel.app/api/v1/infrastructure/graph/health`) intentionally omits the hostname (`REG-NEO-003`). Because the Production hostname itself is unavailable externally, workstation-local DNS resolution failure (`NXDOMAIN` on `374f4f7e.databases.neo4j.io`) and matching graph counts (`9,818` nodes / `9,649` relationships) do NOT by themselves prove whether Production connects to `374f4f7e` or a different AuraDB instance.

zero_credential_private_confirmation_and.step_1_private_console_confirmation: Keep `production_to_374f4f7e_identity_status: UNVERIFIED` until privately confirmed by an authorized admin. Note that query-activity timing on `/api/v1/infrastructure/graph/health` is only a circumstantial clue, NOT conclusive proof. Conclusive private confirmation requires inspecting the configured `NEO4J_URI` 8-character host prefix directly in Vercel Production Settings (or matching the exact AuraDB connection URI / database ID inside the REG24 Aura Console, strictly excluding `RAG24`) without copying or logging credentials.
zero_credential_private_confirmation_and.step_2_separate_export: Once confirmed in Aura Console, export a current snapshot (`.backup` / `.dump`) from Aura Console -> Snapshots -> Export to encrypted local storage outside git, and record its SHA-256 checksum without pausing, resetting, or overwriting the live REG24 graph.
zero_credential_private_confirmation_and.step_3_isolated_loopback_restore: Load the exported archive into a disposable local Docker Neo4j 5 container bound strictly to `127.0.0.1:17687` (`--network none` during `neo4j-admin database load`) and run read-only `scripts/verify-neo4j-374f4f7e-readonly.ts --mode=isolated-restored --expected-instance-id=<confirmed_id>` to verify node/edge/constraint parity.
